title: refactor(Formalism/HermitianCurvature/HermitianCurvatureProofs): reuse CutJDHatJDCapRGrpP helpers in CutJDHatJDCapRGrpM
body:
Expose `isDom_OmP_levTower_base` and `wCell_last_mul_mem_Glev_zero` in `CutJDHatJDCapRGrpP.lean` and reuse them in `CutJDHatJDCapRGrpM.lean` (which already publicly imports `CutJDHatJDCapRGrpP`), removing the 110 lines of duplicated private helpers.

Exposes `Formalism.FourierDecayAlt.P.CutMP.isDom_OmP_levTower_base` and `Formalism.FourierDecayAlt.P.CutMP.wCell_last_mul_mem_Glev_zero` in `CutJDHatJDCapRGrpP.lean`, and removes the duplicate private declarations `isDom_OmP_levTower_base`, `w1_mem_UH_Hpk_of_ne_zero`, `mul_mem_UH_of_mem_of_mem`, `wCell_mem_UH_Hpk_of_ne_zero`, and `wCell_last_mul_mem_Glev_zero` from `CutJDHatJDCapRGrpM.lean`.
